results.title: Big breakthrough in LPU protest: Walkie-talkies found, point to outsiders' role, says Punjab top cop
results.description: Violence erupted at Lovely Professional University following rumors about incidents involving students and outsiders. Walkie-talkies were discovered, prompting an investigation by the Punjab Police into the situation. Police chose dialogue over force, engaging with student grievances and the university administration. The violence was exacerbated by external factors, resulting in vandalism and unrest on campus. A Special Investigation Team has been established to take strict legal action against those responsible.
